A manager title does not determine real signing, technical acceptance, payment, or personnel authority; actual organizational duties must be verified separately, and this is not legal opinion.

Common mistakes are worth verifying: confusing the total budget with the remaining balance, using an old quote, ignoring specification differences, giving unspecific team rework, unclear approval scope, and unconfirmed delivery status. These are a task risk list with no incidence rates.

O*NET11-3061 supports the task background of purchasing procedures, budgets, personnel coordination, specification review, and dispute handling; BLS supports education and experience and statistical scope. The following scenarios and mitigation practices are editorial designs, not official accident rates, employer systems, or legal standards.
Manager, purchasing agent, and budget review roles
Omitting existing commitments distorts the usable budget of a purchasing recommendation, and even a seemingly low single price may exceed it.
List the total budget, committed orders, and remaining balance item by item per M1, then compare the complete cost; budget exceptions follow the prompt and go to Wei Ning.
The M5 draft treats the 30000 yuan total budget as the available amount, while the M1 actual balance is only 18000 yuan.

Using an old total price or delivery date invalidates the comparison and approval basis; whether the latest plan can be approved still requires verifying other conditions.
Retain the timing and substitution relationship, and have the comparison table cite the latest materials; when the version cannot be determined, clarify first.
The M3 16000 yuan and 14:00 arrival have been replaced by the 18000 yuan and 09:00 of M4, and favorable parts cannot be taken from each.

Giving only a ranking or a vague rejection leaves the team unsure which evidence to add; passing on more material than needed also expands exposure.
Point out budget, version, and specification errors by material number, limit the materials and receiving roles that need review, and save the revision basis.
The M5 "chose supplier B because the unit price is low" needs specific rework rather than just asking the purchasing agent to be more careful; this example sends no real materials.

A suitable price and delivery date do not prove the product meets the need; a manager substituting materials on their own removes the technical basis for the purchasing recommendation.

M2 requires 316 while supplier B offers 304, and Xia Zhen's confirmation has not been obtained, so supplier B cannot be approved at 09:00 or treated as equivalent.

A delivery time written on a quote is not the same as an approved order, completed delivery, or completed acceptance; writing it as complete in advance hides the to-dos.

values: Materials and setup | all fictional data designed by the editors

It is now 09:00 on October 1, 2026, and you are the purchasing manager Chen He at the fictional "Qinglan Manufacturing", reviewing the purchasing agent draft; do not contact suppliers, order, or pay. The amounts, people, and rules are for paper practice only.

The M1 department has a purchasing budget of 30000 yuan this week, with committed orders consuming 12000 yuan and other consumption at 0. The M2 need is 100 units of 316-material valves, to be delivered to the designated warehouse before 10:00 on October 2; technical lead Xia Zhen must confirm the specification and acceptance requirements, and no confirmation has been obtained yet.

M3: supplier A quoted September 30 316 valves, 100 units × 160 yuan = 16000 yuan, including tax and delivery, arriving at 14:00 on October 2; supplier B quoted 304 valves, 100 units × 150 yuan = 15000 yuan, plus a 1000 yuan tax-and-delivery fee, total 16000 yuan, arriving at 09:00 on October 2. A new confirmation at 08:30 on October 1 for M4 supplier A replaces the original quote: 17000 yuan for the product including tax ＋ 1000 yuan for all delivery, total 18000 yuan, arriving at 09:00 on October 2. Both supplier A's latest quote and supplier B's quote are valid until 12:00 on October 1.
Tasks and deliverables

M5 exercise rules: when the confirmed technical requirements and delivery date are met and all costs including everything do not exceed the remaining balance, Chen He may approve the purchasing recommendation per the prompt's approval rules; budget exceptions must be approved by finance lead Wei Ning, and signing and payment follow separate organizational procedures. The purchasing agent draft states "available budget this time 30000 yuan; supplier A 16000 yuan; choose supplier B because the unit price is low". Neither purchasing recommendation has been approved.

First independently write a two-row supply condition comparison (specification and quantity, latest total price, delivery date, validity, confirmation status, and material numbers); then write the budget bridge and the three draft correction feedback items; finally give a conditional conclusion at the 09:00 cutoff on whether it can be approved and who must supply evidence. Do not take input from the reference below.
Reference deliverable (complete it before looking)

M1 remaining balance is 30000−12000=18000 yuan. Supplier A must use 17000＋1000=18000 yuan per M4, an amount equal to the balance, and if technical confirmation is later obtained and other conditions are met, total commitments are 12000＋18000=30000 yuan; the M3 16000 yuan for supplier A and the old 14:00 delivery date cannot be carried over.

Supplier B is 15000＋1000=16000 yuan, 2000 yuan lower than supplier A's latest known total price, but M2 requires 316 while supplier B offers 304; the technical lead has not confirmed the specification change, so supplier B cannot be selected directly on the low price. Both latest quotes list arrival at 09:00 on October 2, earlier than the 10:00 need, and technical and other confirmation records still need to be secured; not being approved is not the same as having ordered.

Three items in the M5 draft should be reworked: the available budget wrongly uses the total budget, the supplier A quote omits the latest M4 version, and supplier B is still selected by unit price despite the specification mismatch. At 09:00 no plan is approved; ask the purchasing agent to redo the table and bridge per M1–M5 and to obtain technical confirmation from Xia Zhen; only if a budget exception arises should Wei Ning be contacted per the rules. Suggesting that records be collected before 11:00 to leave review time before the quote deadline is an editorial arrangement, not an original rule.

The exercise reviews paper materials only; Chen He's prompt-level budget approval authority does not imply signing or payment authority, and real organizational authority cannot be presumed from a manager title.

Verify 30000, 12000, 18000, supplier A 17000＋1000 and supplier B 15000＋1000, 316/304, the 08:30 update, the 09:00 cutoff, the 12:00 expiry, and the next-day 09:00/10:00. Without Xia Zhen's confirmation, do not write it as meeting the technical conditions; unapproved remains unapproved.

subject.name: Purchasing Managers
subject.summary: Purchasing managers plan, direct, and coordinate the purchasing team, develop purchasing and contract management procedures, review specifications and purchasing records, control departmental budgets, handle supplier disputes, and organize staff training. This page uses US O*NET11-3061.00 and covers purchasing managers and wholesale and retail merchandise purchasing management positions; it is separate from buyers and purchasing agents who execute specific purchasing. US wages and projections use BLS11-3061 and cannot be converted into Chinese wages; whether there is signing, change, or payment approval authority still depends on organizational authorization.
